= Inline attribute passthroughs
:role-name: hot
:role-markup: +hot+
:icons: font

Plain: key=+{role-name}+ and key=+*hot*+.

Escaped: key=\+{role-name}+.

Xref: xref:target[role=+hot+].

Protected: xref:target[role=+{role-name}+].

Attribute: xref:target[role={role-markup}].

Escape: xref:target[role=\+hot+].

Link: link:https://example.com[Link,role=+hot+,window=+frame+,id=+link-id+].

URL: https://example.com[URL,role=+hot+,window=+frame+,id=+url-id+].

Mail: mailto:user@example.com[Mail,role=+hot+,window=+frame+,id=+mail-id+].

Image: image:thing.png[Alt,title=+title+,link=+https://example.com+,window=+frame+,role=+hot cool+,options=+foo,bar+,id=+image-id+,width=+32+].

Icon: icon:heart[title=+title+,link=+https://example.com+,window=+frame+,role=+hot+,id=+icon-id+,size=+2x+].

Quoted: link:https://example.com[Quoted,role="+hot+ cool"].

Double: link:https://example.com[Double,role=++hot++].

Triple and macro: link:https://example.com[Link,role=+++hot+++] and https://example.com[URL,role=pass:[cool]].

Link protected attribute: link:https://example.com[Link,role=+{role-name}+].

Link attribute: link:https://example.com[Link,role={role-markup}].

Link escape: link:https://example.com[Link,role=\+hot+].

Punctuation: link:https://example.com[Link,role=+hot[0],cool+].

Unicode: xref:target[role=+café+] then *bold*.

Image title: image:thing.png[title=+my title+].

[[target]]
== Target
